label: PD-Lambda-5 system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a PD-Lambda-5 locus represented by DefenseFinder as a two-profile model, PD-Lambda-5__PD-Lambda-5_A and PD-Lambda-5__PD-Lambda-5_B, and experimentally linked to T2, T4, T6, LambdaVir, SECphi17, SECphi18, SECphi27, T3, and T7 protection when expressed in E. coli.
observations: PD-Lambda-5 branch under phage defense system; distinct from the individual PD-Lambda-5 genes or proteins, the DefenseFinder PD-Lambda-5__PD-Lambda-5_A and PD-Lambda-5__PD-Lambda-5_B profiles, the PD-Lambda-5 source key, the P2-like prophage context, phage protection outside a complete PD-Lambda-5 locus, RefSeq example loci without experimental validation, sibling PD-Lambda systems, prophages and mobile genetic elements as mobile elements, and other phage-defense systems.
